title: Personal settings
idea: Personal settings: Account and device settings grouped by effect rather than icon type
audience: People who need to configure within a mobile surface.
worksWellWhen: People change a small set of personal preferences
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic workspace layout through its configure priority and explicit commitment contract: Explain persistence and confirm irreversible account actions
navigation: Personal settings keeps the current configure context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Account and device settings grouped by effect rather than icon type
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to configure; people change a small set of personal preferences
composition.priority: Explain persistence and confirm irreversible account actions

imagery.role: Support the actual configure context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep destructive controls outside frequent preferences
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the personal settings structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no configure content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Explain persistence and confirm irreversible account actions
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized configure content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Explain persistence and confirm irreversible account actions
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active configure context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
